Workday’s non-GAAP operating income for fiscal year 2026 (year ended January 31, 2026) can be derived from the reconciliation table in its FY 2026 earnings release. The reconciliation of GAAP to non-GAAP operating income (in millions) for the year ended January 31, 2026 shows:

- GAAP operating income: $721 million  
- Plus share-based compensation expense: $1,570 million  
- Plus employer payroll tax-related items on employee stock transactions: $62 million  
- Plus amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets: $106 million  
- Plus acquisition-related costs: $62 million  
- Plus restructuring costs: $303 million  

These reconciling items are specifically identified as adjustments to GAAP operating income in the “RECONCILIATION OF GAAP TO NON-GAAP OPERATING INCOME (in millions), Year Ended January 31, 2026” table. [DOC: workday_8k_fy2026.txt]

Summing these amounts (721 + 1,570 + 62 + 106 + 62 + 303) gives a non-GAAP operating income of $2,824 million, or $2.824 billion, for fiscal 2026. [DOC: workday_8k_fy2026.txt]

ANSWER: $2,824 million (non-GAAP operating income for fiscal year 2026, year ended January 31, 2026)
